plan.title: Single-stage RFQ template shows pricing sheet

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the required event title so the create flow is valid.
Choose the first available RFQ template.
Confirm that an RFQ template has been applied to the stage.
Verify that the template rendered the expected pricing-sheet headers.
Confirm the expected sheet configuration control is clickable.
Confirm the expected sheet upload control is clickable.
Confirm the expected details control is clickable.
Confirm the expected price-components control is clickable.
Confirm the expected ranking control is clickable.
Confirm that Participants becomes clickable after the template is selected.
Confirm that Terms & Conditions becomes clickable after the template is selected.
Confirm that the schedule control becomes clickable after the template is selected.
